title: Sachbeschädigungen an Wahlplakaten im Zusammenhang mit der Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus von Berlin

extraction.summaryEn: Several election posters for the Berlin House of Representatives election were vandalised on 19 August 2026, including one set on fire at a lamp post in Schöneberg. The State Protection unit is investigating the damage to posters across several districts.
